status: qualified F16 compressed/index pool ownership and publication component; full native forward remains closed

implementation.ownership: TrellisRequest in existing BnSession backend GPU container owns optional host KV metadata and the same native resident request owns every table/pool/ring allocation. Model/anatomy and backend immutable weight ownership unchanged. Session reset/free finishes device work before releasing all resources.
implementation.layout: F16 source-default DSA pools. Page size256 TOKENS, entries/page256/rate. Per owner pool_c [pages,epp,448], pool_r [pages,epp,64], pool_idx [pages,epp,128]; projected KV/gate rings [256+rate,512]. One immutable identity token-page table per request. Reader layers borrow architecture kv_source owner views; index-selection ownership is separate.
implementation.setup: Separate explicit KV payload/host quotas alongside existing FFN options. Setup stages FFN and KV on one new request and attaches only after successful initialization/completion; any failure destroys all staged resources. Idempotent matching setup; no upgrade/resize of a live request. Pool planning reads architecture ownership/rates, never family predicates.
implementation.publication: Fused device bit-copy of rotated latent/channel splits and index keys through block table. Validate scalar extents, typed exact views, ownership and pairwise disjointness before writes. Backend requires valid injective immutable page IDs; transformer-owned identity table satisfies this without hot readback.
implementation.visibility: Owner-local token cursor and visible entries=cursor/rate. Append or caller-produced rewind<=256 tokens. Incomplete-window zero-entry calls accept canonical empty stages and commit only token cursor after completion. All pool bytes outside written entries remain unchanged; stale entries beyond visibility cannot be attended. Controller commits after one explicit completion fence.
implementation.failure: Malformed scalar/count/controller ownership arguments reject before publication. Backend rejection/execution failure or completion failure conservatively destroys the native request and invalidates every old view until reset/setup. Session whole-model position is not advanced by this component.
implementation.backend_boundary: New transformer ownership uses existing BnBackendScalarKind mapping. GPU mechanics remain backend-private; public GPU backend declaration plus include/wiring only in main CUDA TU. No quant numerical changes or CPU weight handles.

checkpoint.scope: Two separately owned native sessions; same FFN request container, max chunk511. Pools/rings/metadata allocated once. Four owners shared by compressed reader layers2..39; sliding layers0/1 outside this pool API.

source.geometry: cache/dsa.py CacheLayer_dsa and modules/dsv4.py::_forward_cached_one/_indexer_keys. Cache defaults F16; optional quantized pools not admitted here.
source.captures: Preserved original and matched system-cuBLAS captures. Original compressor source captures provide projected/ring/unrotated stage data; independent Torch matmul plus original norm/RoPE source CABI derive keys and rotate latents, then Torch indexed assignment publishes source pools. Candidate output never seeds references.

correctness.comparison: Native backend-owned checkpoint matrices/norms; production compressor -> latent key operation -> production transformer publication. Both entire projected-row rings, raw KV/gate projections, rotated stage, projected/rotated keys, positions and all complete pools byte-exact. Two sessions reuse fixed guarded stage buffers; all shared-reader aliases verified and session cursor isolation checked.
correctness.frames: Each owner continuous chunks1/1/3/7/31/32/33/257/1/511 through token877, then rewind750 for7 and757 for33. Includes rate2 zero-entry call, partial windows, page crossings, chunk>ring and stale pool tails.
correctness.ownership: Exact KV payload allocation delta agrees with plan. Short device/host quotas reject before request creation. Matching setup allocates nothing. Live FFN-only request cannot be upgraded; incompatible KV capacity rejected. Three injected mid-KV allocation failures and one setup completion failure detach/free all staged resources. Publication completion failure destroys request; reset/setup restores zero pools/cursors. Backend alias rejection also destroys request. Immutable model config preserved.
correctness.synthetic: 72 independent Torch bit-copy fixtures x2 requests=144 calls; F16 all-bit-pattern inputs including NaNs/zero signs, D32/128/512, rates1/2, identity/permuted8-page tables, page boundaries/tail capacity, rows1/7/31/32/33/511. Full output hashes, guards, immutable inputs/table and late-invalid-plan/foreign-request/alias rejection.

trace.scope: One warmed layer20 rate1 chunk511: production compressor and latent-key operations plus transformer-owned publication/completion. Input/metadata uploads and reference readbacks outside capture. Component pipeline only, not complete attention/model throughput.

limitations: Explicit F16 compressed/index pool component. Compressor and index-key producer orchestration is qualified by the probe; production full attention controller, frequency construction and compressor norm/zero-metadata setup still need integration.
No SWA ring, index-query scoring/topk/candidate selection, attention, F32 attention de-rotation, grouped output projection, Engram or complete native forward/generation/CLI admission.

No cache quantization, global cross-request page allocator, prefix sharing/eviction, CPU tier or concurrent KV scheduling yet. Requests own separate private paged pools and immutable identity maps; generic backend publication also qualifies permuted tables.
Host quota covers owned KV metadata and setup table scratch; device quota covers payload, excluding backend/driver/allocator descriptor overhead and immutable model/expert caches.

ASAN/UBSAN instruments probe, transformer Trellis/KV ownership, session/backend-session and selected model/reader/layout C sources; CUDA TU host validation is not claimed ASAN-instrumented. Device memcheck/leak/init/race tools separately passed.
Qualified selected sm_120a only; no full-model performance, vLLM parity or serving-tail claim.
